answer: Re-attestations are stored in pearl and lantern lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the walnut graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 2102 identities would post 3361 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
